'''Cactobloom''' is a [[Grass]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Cactobud]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Cactoczar]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

== Overview ==
Current Description: "Cactobloom loves putting on little tricks for Tatari, like rolling through berry bushes and coming out covered in fruit. It's a talent that's earned plenty of berry-loving friends."

Cactobloom is a gold rarity Tatari.

== Appearance ==
A green cactus creature with tiny eyes and pink flowers on its head and arms. It stands bipedal on short legs and has a zig-zag shaped mouth.

Cactobloom's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form is bright cyan instead of green.

== Evolution Trial ==
Cactobloom's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Cactoczar]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Cactobloom to increase stats 3 times.
* Shoot 20,000 pinballs.

* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "With arms always open for a hug, Cactobloom dreams of making friends with flowers and warmth, although most Tatari run the other way."
